description: This file defines an abstract repository class 'ContentRepository' for content data handling in a Flutter application. It specifies methods for fetching content feeds, searching content, retrieving content by ID, managing playback progress, and handling watch history, serving as an interface for content data operations.

classes.name: ContentRepository
classes.description: An abstract class defining the interface for content data operations including fetching, searching, retrieving by ID, and managing playback and history.

methods.name: fetchHomeFeed
methods.description: Fetches the home feed content payload.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search for content items based on the query string.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a content item by its unique ID.

methods.name: cacheBuster
methods.description: A ValueListenable that can be used to trigger cache refresh events.

methods.name: recordPlaybackProgress
methods.description: Records the playback progress for a specific content item.

methods.name: recordPlaybackCompleted
methods.description: Marks the playback as completed for a specific content item.

methods.name: getPlaybackProgressSeconds
methods.description: Retrieves the current playback progress in seconds for a content item.

methods.name: getRecentWatchHistory
methods.description: Fetches recent watch history entries, limited by the specified number.
